text: Check camera access permission: system dialog should appear after request and show preview
Simulate geolocation request: verify user consent and coordinate display on map
Enable microphone permission, record audio message through website and play it back
Verify that when Bluetooth device connects, successful pairing notification appears
Simulate text paste from clipboard: verify input field accepts copied value
Take screenshot via browser API, ensure file appears in device gallery
Invoke system share sheet on Android and share link via messenger
Test ambient light sensor permission request, display brightness level on UI
Test form autofill functionality through system password manager (iOS/Android)
Verify app theme switching to dark/light according to OS settings
Invoke system Wi-Fi selection menu when attempting to load page in offline mode
Test app response to airplane mode activation — notify user about lost connection
Enable notifications via web API, ensure notifications appear in system notification panel
Test haptic feedback (vibration) during mobile swipe gestures
Take photo via webcam and add it as user profile avatar
Simulate orientation sensor usage: rotate device and verify layout change
Test app transition to split-screen mode and interface functionality correctness
Refresh page on battery-low system event, show warning
Insert image via drag'n'drop from system gallery
Test website response to USB connections (e.g., data upload from flash drive via browser)
Test QR code generation and scanning via mobile device camera
Get contacts list via API, verify display in app address book
Simulate fingerprint/faceID authentication for secure app section access
Test handling of user denial for microphone access (error notification should appear)
On Android enable split screen and ensure app doesn't break layout
Simulate geolocation attempt on device without GPS — app should correctly report error
Test camera failure (e.g., hardware error) and fallback UI display
Test browser with connected physical keyboard on tablet: standard hotkeys work in input
Invoke NFC scanner on Android for payment, test app response
Verify that clipboard access attempts require explicit user confirmation
Simulate disabled notification permission and ensure app responds correctly
Use Web Bluetooth API: search nearby devices, handle Bluetooth unavailable error
Enable battery saver mode, ensure heavy animations are disabled
Test OS calendar integration: create event via web-app and find it in system calendar
Make avatar editing from camera unavailable when hardware is physically disconnected
Enable hardware mute and ensure video/audio doesn't play
Test filesystem access denial scenario via browser API on iOS
Test instant UI update on SIM card change and automatic number detection
Play multimedia file, minimize app (background), ensure playback pauses
